title: Foreground dev server in main agent flow
summary: Launching a long-running dev server in the primary conversation flow blocks progress and steals the control loop
remedy: Prefer help/build/probe commands; if a live server is truly needed, start it in background with explicit intent, log path, and shutdown ownership

title: Descriptor lazy-import did not slim deos chunk
summary: Moving the .papi/descriptors import behind a dynamic import inside web-client/src/lib/adapters/blockchain/deos.ts did not materially reduce the emitted deos client chunk; the descriptor barrel was already chunk-split, so this adds complexity without improving the hotspot.
remedy: Measure first, then target the real deos/bootstrap hotspot instead of adding async descriptor indirection

title: Premature micro-optimization before product need
summary: Do not add lazy-loading, bundle indirection, or similar performance complexity while the project is still raw unless tests, profiling, validation tooling, or real user/operator pain prove a concrete hotspot. Prefer business-facing delivery first and revert optimizations that do not produce meaningful wins.
remedy: Measure first, optimize second, and prioritize correctness, product flows, and contract honesty over speculative micro-optimizations

title: Direct pallet_xcm FRAME benchmark registration
summary: Adding pallet_xcm directly to runtime define_benchmarks with pallet_xcm::Pallet<Runtime> fails because that type does not implement FRAME Benchmarking in SDK 2603.
remedy: Register pallet_xcm benchmarks through pallet_xcm::benchmarking::Pallet::<Runtime> and implement pallet_xcm::benchmarking::Config for the runtime benchmark API.

title: FRAME provider does not bypass pallet-balances ED
summary: On Polkadot SDK 2606 pallet-balances v50, fungible can_deposit and transfer reject a new Balances account below ExistentialDeposit even when frame_system already holds a provider reference; provider-only preflight heuristics cannot make that transfer valid.
remedy: The DEOS runtime funds explicit free-ED anchors for native-flow topology accounts while generic AAA retains exact ledger consequences.

title: Reserved native balance does not bypass pallet-balances deposit consequence
summary: A runtime probe with an external FRAME provider, zero free balance, and a full ExistentialDeposit held in pallet-balances reserved balance still returns BelowMinimum through fungible can_deposit for a sub-ED free deposit; pallet-balances v50 compares new free balance directly with ED before considering reserved balance.
remedy: Use funded free-ED anchors at the runtime topology boundary; do not retry provider-only or reserved-only heuristics.

title: Rejected primary strategies for native sub-ED AAA ingress
summary: Upstream semantic changes, custom native accounting, and removal of the exact free-zero requirement were rejected as the primary DEOS strategy. Accumulation above ED remains only a possible future policy fallback, not the current transfer contract.
remedy: Fund one persistent free ED for admitted System AAA, custody, and staking-ingress accounts; preserve it through task resolution and consume only newly received conversion amounts.
